description: This file defines an interface 'IXGraphicsRenderer' for an abstract drawing surface in a PDF rendering library, including method signatures for various drawing operations, state management, transformations, clipping, and miscellaneous functions.

classes.name: IXGraphicsRenderer
classes.description: An interface representing a drawable surface for PDFs, with methods for drawing shapes, images, text, and managing graphic state.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the graphics surface.

methods.name: DrawLine
methods.description: Draws a straight line between two points.

methods.name: DrawLines
methods.description: Draws multiple straight lines connecting a sequence of points.

methods.name: DrawBezier
methods.description: Draws a Bézier spline defined by four control points.

methods.name: DrawBeziers
methods.description: Draws multiple Bézier splines through a set of points.

methods.name: DrawCurve
methods.description: Draws a cardinal spline through specified points with a given tension.

methods.name: DrawArc
methods.description: Draws an arc segment within specified bounds and angles.

methods.name: DrawRectangle
methods.description: Draws a rectangle with optional pen and brush.

methods.name: DrawRectangles
methods.description: Draws multiple rectangles.

methods.name: DrawRoundedRectangle
methods.description: Draws a rectangle with rounded corners.

methods.name: DrawEllipse
methods.description: Draws an ellipse within specified bounds.

methods.name: DrawPolygon
methods.description: Draws a polygon defined by a set of points.

methods.name: DrawPie
methods.description: Draws a pie shape (segment of an ellipse).

methods.name: DrawClosedCurve
methods.description: Draws a closed cardinal spline curve.

methods.name: DrawPath
methods.description: Draws a custom graphics path.

methods.name: DrawString
methods.description: Draws text glyphs within a layout rectangle.

methods.name: DrawImage
methods.description: Draws an image at specified location and size.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves the current graphics state.

methods.name: Restore
methods.description: Restores a previously saved graphics state.

methods.name: BeginContainer
methods.description: Begins a new graphics container with specific transformations.

methods.name: EndContainer
methods.description: Ends a graphics container.

methods.name: AddTransform
methods.description: Applies a transformation matrix to the graphics context.

methods.name: SetClip
methods.description: Sets a clipping path with a specified mode.

methods.name: ResetClip
methods.description: Resets any clipping path.

methods.name: WriteComment
methods.description: Writes a comment to the output stream (non-rendering).
